reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge lies in transforming structured game data into engaging, real-time narratives without sacrificing clarity or scalability. The proposed system uses a two-phase approach: first, rule-based templates map structured inputs to candidate narratives; second, machine learning refines these outputs for naturalness. Transfer learning via T5 allows rapid adaptation to new domains, while back translation enhances readability. The failure mode occurs when templates are too rigid or when ML fails to generalize, leading to incoherent or overly verbose outputs. The system's robustness depends on balancing template consistency with adaptive learning, ensuring that narratives remain both accurate and accessible.
